species.real: Ascension's sooty terns are called wideawakes after their call, a cry that goes on day and night across the colony.
species.name: Wideling

dex.text: A small black-and-white tern with a forked tail and an opinion about everything. It calls all night, which is how it got the name, and also how it got a great many complaints.
dex.fact: The sooty tern spends years at sea after fledging and rarely settles on the water, because its plumage is not waterproof. Huge breeding colonies nest on the Chagos islands, and on Ascension the birds are known as wideawakes.

species.real: Sooty terns on Ascension breed roughly every ten months rather than once a year, so the colony's timing drifts round the calendar.
species.name: Wideawake

dex.text: A tern that has not landed in years and would like you to stop asking. It sleeps, if it sleeps at all, on the wing, and it arrives with the weather already behind it.
dex.fact: Sooty terns can stay airborne for years between breeding attempts, feeding over warm tropical seas. They are among the most numerous seabirds of the tropics, and a colony in full cry is loud enough to be heard from the beach.
